assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to guide further management of rate control and anticoagulation therapy.
The service is supported by the documented diagnoses I49.5, I48.91, and R55.
The precertification requirement noted in payer correspondence was not satisfied.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
As the provider, you may submit a formal appeal within ninety days of this notice.
Please include all supporting clinical documentation and the missing authorization number, if available, to facilitate a comprehensive review.
Failure to provide adequate justification may result in the final determination of non-coverage.
